timer_plan.rationale: All requirements are evaluated per invocation; no timing delay is specified.

priorities: E-stop overrides every request and transitions to INHIBITED in the same scan.
While inhibited, Run remains false; reset is accepted only when EStopNC and Reset are true and both Start and Stop are false.
After reset acceptance, the motor remains stopped for that scan. A later permitted Start scan is required.
When enabled, Stop overrides Start; with neither asserted, the run state is retained.
Start and Reset are level-sensitive; Reset is ignored when already enabled.
Implement the physical emergency-stop safety function using an appropriately rated independent safety circuit; standard PLC scan logic alone does not provide instantaneous physical isolation.

initial_values.initialization: Apply these as the fresh pre-invocation state, including on power-up; scan 0 executes normally. Do not restore a retained running state.

scan_execution_order.name: Edge sampling
scan_execution_order.action: Sample all four input levels once. No edge detectors are required; use the sampled levels throughout the scan.

scan_execution_order.name: Safety/reset priority and state transitions
scan_execution_order.action: Read the pre-scan state and select exactly one next state using the listed guards and priority. E-stop is evaluated first.

scan_execution_order.name: Unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF
scan_execution_order.action: No timer FB instances are required, so this stage performs no calls.

scan_execution_order.name: Unified output assignments
scan_execution_order.action: Assign Run and ResetRequired once from the selected next state's output mapping, then retain that state for the next invocation.
